name: openai/math
title: OpenAI model proves the matrix multiplication exponent is exactly 9/4
summary: After an October upper bound of 9/4, an OpenAI model has now produced a matching lower bound, so the exponent for multiplying n x n matrices is claimed to be exactly 2.25; the author notes it also implies linear programs solvable in n^(9/4) time. A milestone for AI-assisted mathematics, with a public preprint to check.
